head_commit.message:
[fix][windows-env]: scope PR 5579 to DEFAULT_ENV_VARS only

Context:
* Reviewer requested separating concerns; keep env passthrough low-risk changes in this PR.

Change:
* Revert PATH precedence changes in arg0 and Node wrapper (restore prepend).
* Remove PATH<->Path aliasing logic and test from rmcp-client; retain expanded DEFAULT_ENV_VARS.

Risk:
* None beyond reverting to upstream behavior for PATH order and aliasing; env list expansion preserved.

Tests:
* Ran just fmt; just fix -p codex-arg0, codex-rmcp-client.
* cargo test -p codex-rmcp-client -> all tests pass.

Verification:
* Diff for PR now limited to DEFAULT_ENV_VARS in rmcp-client.

head_commit.message:
[App Server] Allow fetching or resuming a conversation summary from the conversation id (#5890)

This PR adds an option to app server to allow conversation summaries to
be fetched from just the conversation id rather than rollout path for
convenience at the cost of some latency to discover the rollout path.

This convenience is non-trivial as it allows app servers to simply
maintain conversation ids rather than rollout paths and the associated
platform (Windows) handling associated with storing and encoding them
correctly.

head_commit.message:
[App Server] Allow fetching or resuming a conversation summary from the conversation id (#5890)

This PR adds an option to app server to allow conversation summaries to
be fetched from just the conversation id rather than rollout path for
convenience at the cost of some latency to discover the rollout path.

This convenience is non-trivial as it allows app servers to simply
maintain conversation ids rather than rollout paths and the associated
platform (Windows) handling associated with storing and encoding them
correctly.
